## Findings
- claim-1: Metadata identifies *Presenting the cohomology of a Schubert variety: Proof of the minimality conjecture*, Avery St. Dizier and Alexander Yong (2024), DOI 10.1112/jlms.12832; its abstract states that it proves the minimality conjecture using the Hopf algebra of symmetric functions. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832]
- claim-2: No stable full-text copy of DOI 10.1112/jlms.12832, no source-registry identifier, no file digest, and no page or line locators were supplied.
## Strategy
Use only the recorded DOI metadata/abstract evidence; no full-text source was supplied for ingestion.

## Gaps
No immutable source-registry object, full-text file, digest, archival URL, or stable page/line locators for DOI `10.1112/jlms.12832` are available. The requested ingestion target is **not established**. Exact theorem applicability to project parameters is also unresolved.
